newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mahindra in auto component project.
newsitem.headline: India Mahindra in auto component project.

text.p: Indian tractor and jeepmaker Mahindra & Mahindra is working on an automobile components project in the southern state of Tamil Nadu, a spokesman said.
"We are working on an auto ancillary project. But it is in a very preliminary stage," he said.
The Business Standard reported that the Tamil Nadu state government signed a memorandum of understanding with Mahindra for setting up an automobile ancillary park.
It quoted state officials as saying the park would come up south of the proposed Mahindra Ford plant near the city.
Mahindra Ford, a 50-50 venture between Mahindra and Ford Motor Company of U.S. is building a car plant near the city.
